newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices steady on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices steady on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose marginally on demand from overseas buyers, brokers said.
Brokers said good liquoring teas attracted buyers for Poland, Pakistan and Russia. Local blenders were also active, they said.

More than 975,880 kg of teas were sold at the auction. The average tea prices was 44.04 taka, up 0.13 from the previous sale. The next auction will be held on October 29 with an offer of 1.27 million kg of teas.
